ImageDescription.value: Kregel Windmill Factory Museum turret lathe. Belts are made out of bison hide. If a belt snaps, it simply falls to the floor. David Silcox, President of the Kregel Windmill Factory Board, recommends watching the Ken Burns documentary "The American Buffalo" to learn more about the history of bison in Nebraska.
